description: This file is an HTML document for a web-based database viewer UI, including embedded CSS and JavaScript for dynamic functionality such as loading databases, tables, and data, and rendering interactive tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling objects and large content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full view.

search-terms: API data fetch for databases and tables
